name: pond-rim
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap asset for a children's painted mobile farm game. Reference 1 is the approved farm-a painting style, palette and soft southwest light; reference 2 is the neighboring dirt/grass material. Make the requested isolated terrain decal, not a whole scene. Strict orthographic straight-down ground view, no horizon, no perspective. Match warm softly painted farm-a greens and ochre earth; no black outlines, text, borders, buildings, characters or object cast shadows. Preserve native transparent background, never bake a checkerboard or white matte. Requested asset: a single closed horizontal elliptical pond shoreline RING, aspect ratio 2:1, fully visible with small transparent outer margin. The large central oval MUST BE COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT, with absolutely no water pixels: the game's separate animated water goes through the hole. Thin irregular earthy bank surrounded by short green grass, scattered rounded warm grey stones and a few sparse low reeds. No bridge, dock, animals or lily pads. Continuous natural bank all the way around; interior water hole approximately 75% of outer width and 65% of outer height. Landscape 2:1 canvas, ring centered. Soft local southwest highlights only, no long shadows.
